facts.text: Senor, I bring tidings and a hairball. The king wants dinner, and I want to be fed. Also, I am great at this job.
facts.why: Not a Puss line. His real lines on Wikiquote include a pricing line from when King Harold hires him. The quote is shorter than the current note and fits the panel.
facts.fix: You are told correct. But for this, I charge a great deal of money.

vibe.verdict: The hotel layout suits Far Far Away and the food in-jokes (Poison Apple, Fat Boy, Muffin Man) land well, but the note is invented and Donkey barely features.
